lines.en: : Ahh...Finally, some peace and quiet.
: You know, you’d think kyudo of all things would be the quietest of all the clubs...but between Uta and Kirin, I just don’t know sometimes.
: That’s weird.  Uta’s usually so focused when it comes to archery.
: Yeah, but Kirin does this thing where she pollutes any environment she’s thrown into and, sometimes, that leads to Uta getting pulled back to her normal Uta-ish ways.
: I never have to worry about that with you, though. Because even when you’re talkative, which doesn’t happen much, you’re still kind of quiet.
: And you’re kind of hugging my leg so hard that it’s cutting off my circulation.
: That’s fine. I can probably make a sweet prosthetic after a few tries. Believe in me, Sensei. I’ll help you learn to walk again.
I find myself in...what I believe is the tea ceremony room, but I might be incorrect about that as all I can remember from the last time I was in here is how red Uta’s face was.
But this time, I’ve taken up temporary residence with her best friend instead and Uta is none the wiser.
All the while, I cautiously and quietly bang invisible nails into an invisible wall I put up around myself to remind me not to do what isn’t welcome with today’s guest.
Not to make any sort of advances or allude to any sort of impurity- because that wall is visible to one person and that person is, you guessed it...me.
I can do this.
I did it with Molly and I can do it with Io.
I can accept that not everyone has an inherent desire to sleep with me and I can grow in ways dissimilar to the way I grow the most.
I can be a better person.
I can learn to protect things.
And if I can be better, that means Io can too.

The two of us are adaptable. We’re different in a million other ways, but our resilience and the fact that our skin can camouflage to match its surroundings is what makes the two of us work as well as we do.
Or as well as I think we do.
Or as well as she thinks we do, but I don’t understand because the way I think isn’t the way she thinks and the things I do aren’t the things she’d do when the two of us are thinking.
When the two of us are thinking is when we grow the closest.
But it’s also the scariest time of all — because every single word strips a plank from the bridge between us.
And one day, when we’re older and exhausted, our skin will lose its color.
One of us will lose the will to adapt.
And sometimes, it feels like it’s a race to get to that point and see who will break first.
But right now, the two of us are thinking.
And only one of us has thoughts that can be spoken out loud.
: Hey...Sensei?
: Yeah?
: I really like you.
: I know. You’ve already confessed on multiple occasions.
: I’m just gonna keep doing it, you know.
: I feel safe when I’m with you. Which makes me want to confess my feelings because it’s the one time I know I’m not going to be judged for them.
: I judge you all the time. The same way you judge me.
: Sure, but it seems to me like we keep ruling in one another’s favor if we can still sit here like this.
: Then it seems to me like your judgement is just as shot as everything else about you.
: Yeah. I kinda suck, don’t I?
: And you have stupid hair.
: And I’m really mean to all the girls you like.
: Remind me, why do you keep me around again? What are you getting out of this? Because we already know it’s not the thing you want.
: What I’m getting is the opportunity to spend time with a cute girl that’s hopelessly devoted to me.
: But you’ve got tons of those. And most of them don’t have stupid hair or stupid mental health issues.
: Then I guess I’m just a masochist and like making things difficult for myself.
: Ahh, yes. The “When life gives you lemons, squeeze them into your eyes” method. I know it quite well.
: Has your reason for wanting to be with me expanded beyond just “I was in the right place at the right time” yet?
: Of course. Do you really think I could just endlessly hug anyone? It should be obvious how precious you are to me by now.
: Just don’t ask me to describe why or how since I don’t have a reasonable explanation for it and will likely just make it sound like I don’t really care when, in all actuality, I do.
: I care a lot.
: I even had a dream about you last night. You wanna hear it?
: Was I better or worse in the dream than I am in real life?
: You were a cat.
: I...can’t figure out which one of the categories I listed that falls into.
: Do you ever dream about me?
: Do you ever dream about anything?
: It’s not uncommon for some people to just never dream, you know. And I won’t be offended if REM-Sensei isn’t wasting any thoughts on Io when Io isn’t even worth any thoughts in real life.
: It’s not like I don’t dream or anything...I just don’t do it very often and, when I do, what I see normally doesn’t make much sense.
: But the question I posed was if you ever see me. Even if it’s for something weird, like...helping you build a go-kart or something.
: I...can’t really remember. But I’ll try and keep track for your sake if it makes you happy.
: You’re being really nice today. Do you feel weird around me now?
: Io, come on.
: What? It’s a genuine question. I’m difficult enough as-is. The last thing I need is you having another reason to show up at somebody else’s door instead of mine.
: Well, if I said yes, what would you even do about it?
: Internally? Hate myself. Externally? Maybe a big hug or something.
: You still haven’t cashed in on that kiss I said you could have. That might pull you back to my side, right?
: I don’t think it’s a good idea for us to do that right now.
: Why not?
: Trust me. It’s just better for both of us if we stick to...cuddling or whatever for now.
: Why do you always pause like that before you say cute words like “cuddle?”

: Come to think of it, you never really say anything cute in the first place. It’s always straight-laced, semi-formal dialogue with you. Like you’re following the unofficial handbook on mid-thirties male speech.
: Early-thirties. And I don’t know. That’s just kind of how I talk, I guess.
: There wasn’t like, somebody who taught you to speak that way? To never say anything fun?
: I say fun stuff all the time. Or...at least I think it’s fun. But I’ve been calling this my hot boy summer for months and no one has laughed yet, so maybe my sense of humor just sucks.
: Say more fun things around me. Tell me a joke or something. Go.
: Uhh...
: I’m waiting.
: Yeah, I’m aware. It’s been two seconds. It’s just kind of hard to think of any jokes on the spot like that.
: I have one! You wanna hear it?
: Yes, but I will judge you harshly if it’s not funny.
: Deal. What do corporate woodworkers do when they need to discuss their next project?
: They have a board meeting!
: Get it? Like...board. Like...wood. A wooden board.
: I get it. That silence was just me judging you harshly.
: Hey, it could’ve been worse. It could’ve been, like...Tsuneyo’s stand-up set bad.
: I am...very thankful it was not.
: What was that even about anyway? Like, raunchy humor is one thing...but to just blatantly start spreading ridiculous lies about people? That’s like...kind of fucked up, isn’t it?
: Thank god nobody believed her. Cause all that stuff about the chuuni girl was actually nauseating. And another thing-
: Hey, on the topic of the Dorm Wars, how are you feeling going into this year’s competition? Are you actually going to try?
: I’m glad you asked! Because I am going to try this year!
: Crazy things happen when you let Io do a thing Io actually wants to do. Which, to be fair, isn’t many things. But building a raft? That sounds super fun. I’ve never tried anything like that before.
: Plus, I get to compete against Miku! And I don’t despise her!
: Yeah...you two seem to be seeing each other pretty often nowadays, huh?
: That’s right! I am her pharmacist after all.
: Except...you’re not. You’re a random girl with a surplus of pills who doesn’t mind handing them out to other people.
: Isn’t that what pharmacists do?
: Io, I’m trying to lecture you.
: Why?! Today was going so well! Can’t we save all the serious conversation until next time or something?
I shift my lower body away from Io and inadvertently force her off of me.
There’s a moment of hesitance as she tries to figure out whether or not she should attempt to steal my leg again- and there’s a second moment when she reaches toward me with lightly-trembling hands.
My lack of morals prevents me from swatting her away as I don’t think it’s right to punish anyone for anything when I’m sure I’ve done much worse.
But I do stare into her eyes in a way I’ve only done a few times before.
I haven’t had to look this way at any other girl — but Io feels less like a girl and more like a feral cat I need  to housebreak at times.
She does so many things that just go against all common sense, but...
I guess I do too.
And I guess that might be why she sees me the same way in her sleep.
: Am I in trouble?
: Do I have the authority to ground you?
: Not technically. But I like you enough to humor you by acting grounded. Plus, it’s not like I ever go anywhere in the first place. If anything, being grounded sounds kind of like a vacation.
: Io, why are you medicating Miku when-
: Because no one else is!
: I’m doing it because no one else is...
: Miku’s got severe PTSD that was entirely untreated before I started sharing my medication with her.
: Do you have any idea what it’s like having to just fucking...raw dog that? It’s terrible. And it was holding her back from...living a normal life.
: And living a normal life when your trauma is that fucking earth-shattering?...Well, that's...that's one of the hardest things anyone could ever even attempt to do.
: But that doesn’t make it okay to-
: Well, what would you do instead?! Have her just deal with it on her own?!
: You’ve seen her panic attacks, right?! She can barely breathe when they happen! And it’s not like you can just prevent her triggers from ever showing up, right?! So then what?! What would you do?!
: I’d...leave it to the professionals.
: Oh, so they could throw a bunch of shit at her and just see which one sticks?! It takes forever to find the right medication for some people! Not to mention dosage and the cost and-
: And you’re not even her guardian! In fact, she doesn’t even have a guardian if I’m understanding her situation correctly!
: There’s nothing anyone can do but me and I can’t just sit back and watch her suffer when I know I can help!
: I know you’re just trying to help. But what you’re doing is dangerous and you know that.
: You know what’s even more dangerous? Not treating her.
: Miku is doing a million times better now. And that’s not just me saying it to save face. She’ll tell you herself.
: Fuck, she probably doesn’t even need to tell you. Just take one look at her and you’ll realize how much easier her life has gotten lately.
: I know Miku way better than you do, Io.
: Then you should know how much help she needs.
: Too many people just shrug mental health issues off because it makes them uncomfortable and it’s shit like that that winds up killing people.
: I’m not going to abandon her when I’m making a real difference in her life. You know that’s what I want to do with mine. I’ve told you that.
: When you told me that, you were talking about toys...not pills.
: Right, yeah. Let’s just pull her off the working medication and throw a fucking toy at her the next time she has a panic attack. That’ll work.
: Io, that’s not what I’m suggesting and you know that.
: Of course I know that. But I’m mad at you right now and I’m probably going to be a little more sarcastic than normal for a few minutes. If that’s going to be a problem, then just leave.
: You really care about Miku, don’t you?
: Not really.
: So you’re doing all of this for...what? The principle of it?
: I’m doing it for myself. But not in a “Playing pharmacist makes me feel like I have a purpose” sort of way.
: I’m doing it because if I had to look my issues in the eye, I know how I’d feel. And I wouldn’t wish that on my worst fucking enemy.
: So...what then?
: I don’t know. Sounds like you’re gonna tell on me or something. And then Miku will just be fucked until someone else comes along and decides she’s worth helping.
: I’m not the type to “tell” on anyone, Io.
: You just have to realize how this looks from the outside.
: It just seems pretty fucked up that I got confronted for helping her before anyone confronted her about getting help.
: That’s the kind of shit people like me have to go through, Sensei. No one ever helps themselves. It always starts with somebody talking us into doing something and then us figuring shit out later.
: God forbid I ever try and be that for another person. God forbid I ever do anything that isn’t in my best interest.
: But didn’t you say just a second ago that you were doing this for yourself?
: Shut up.
: You really do care about her after all, huh?
: No.
: Do you want to lay on my lap again?
: Huh? Aren’t we mad at each other?
: I was a little mad in the beginning. But not anymore after hearing your rationale behind all this.
: So...wait. Where does that put us in regard to the medication situation? Can I keep sharing my stuff with Miku?
: I...won’t stop you. But I want you to try and talk her into getting help from an actual professional rather than someone who just...has way too much experience.
: I’m not good at talking. You know this. If I talk to Miku, she’ll probably give up on taking medication altogether and just jump off a bridge.
: Then give her a phone number or...something. I don’t know. I have no idea how any of this works.
: Sensei...
: What now? I thought that was a pretty good ending to all of this.
: It was, just...
: Have you...
: Have you really never tried taking anything to help with your...problems?
: You don’t have to go it alone, you know.
: Are you going to start treating me now too?
: Don’t turn this into a joke. I think you could really stand to benefit from...something.
: I’m just...not sure what.
: I’ll be fine. I’ve made it to 31 without anything like that and I’ll make it to 32 if the world ever goes back to-
: I just really think you should reconsider. I want you to be happy and...it’s not like anything I can do will ever get you to that point.
: Sensei?
: Just lay back down, Io.
Io's affection has increased to [io_love]!
